problem: Find $B=\overset{―}{A}$, where $A=[\begin{aligned}9-7\text{i} & -2\text{i} & 6-\text{i} \\ -7 & 5-\text{i} & \text{i} \\ 6 & -\text{i} & 0\end{aligned}].$ What is the value of ${b}_{21}+{b}_{32}?$

feedback.problem: Find $B=\overset{―}{A}$, where $A=[\begin{aligned}5+4\text{i} & -6\text{i} \\ -5+7\text{i} & 8-3\text{i}\end{aligned}].$ What is the value of ${b}_{21}-{b}_{22}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Taking the complex conjugate of each entry, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{A} & =\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}5+4\text{i} & -6\text{i} \\ -5+7\text{i} & 8-3\text{i}\end{aligned}]} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{5+4\text{i}} & \overset{―}{-6\text{i}} \\ \overset{―}{-5+7\text{i}} & \overset{―}{8-3\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5-4\text{i} & 6\text{i} \\ -5-7\text{i} & 8+3\text{i}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${b}_{21}-{b}_{22}=(-5-7\text{i})-(8+3\text{i})=-13-10\text{i}.$
